name: Warrior Grand Prix: Round 1

date.source: BodyCount's own results column, posted 15 September 2012 to its BodyCount Warrior Grand Prix Roleplay sub-forum, recapping the round's own roleplay window (10-14 September 2012)

matches.note: Umaga Reihana won via TKO one minute into the third round.
Mike Sodo won by armbar submission in thirty seconds of the first round.
The card announces Jakob Alexander was deported before the bout and Viktor Reise is awarded the win; the source itself bills this as a 'No Contest' despite naming a winner.
Michael Vayne won via knockout two minutes into the second round.
John St. Abraham refuses, in character, to fight and leaves; Dave Hendrix is awarded the win. The source itself bills this as a 'No Contest' despite naming a winner.

notes: The opening round of BodyCount's first Warrior Grand Prix tournament. Ten of the sixteen listed entrants appear in a narrated bout this round; no result survives in the held record for the other six (Teddy Alexander, Marisol Hawkes, Jessica Harmony, Brendan Dean, Jonathan Stark and Frank Dylan James), an honest gap rather than an omission. The card also awards 'golden tickets' (a further chance) to Johannes Antonious de Castonovo and Pat Gordon Jr., both of whom lost their own bouts this round.

name: Warrior Grand Prix: Round 2

date.source: BodyCount's own results column, posted 22 September 2012 to its BodyCount Warrior Grand Prix Roleplay sub-forum

matches.note: Dave Hendrix won by submission (a rear-naked choke) at 4:05 of the first round.
Jonathan Stark won via knockout (front kick) at 0:45 of the first round.
Viktor Reise won via TKO at 1:50 of the first round.
Jakob Alexander won by split decision after the full three rounds.

notes: The second round of BodyCount's first Warrior Grand Prix, trimming the field from ten (after two golden-ticket entrants and four opening-round byes) to four. The card also names Umaga Reihana and Michael Vayne as already advanced to the semifinals on their own Round 1 byes.

name: Warrior Grand Prix: Round 3

date.source: BodyCount's own results column, posted 30 September 2012 to its BodyCount Warrior Grand Prix Roleplay sub-forum

matches.note: Dave Hendrix won by leg-lock submission at 3:52 of the third and final round, on a 3-2 judges' decision.
Jakob Alexander won via TKO at 4:55 of the third and final round, on a 3-2 judges' decision.

notes: The card bills this round's own winners, alongside Umaga Reihana and Michael Vayne, as the tournament's four semifinalists. A semifinal round pairing Umaga Reihana against Jakob Alexander and Michael Vayne against Dave Hendrix was announced for the following week (see the collected, uncompleted semifinal show below); the fed's own finals recap (21 October 2012) instead states that Dave Hendrix failed a drug test and Viktor Reise was reinstated into the final in his place, after Jonathan Stark's own planned redemption match against Reise was cancelled when Stark's handler could not return to the story in time.

name: Warrior Grand Prix: Semifinals

date.source: BodyCount's own Round 3 results column (30 September 2012) announces the semifinal pairings for the following week; two promo threads for these bouts are dated 1-6 October 2012

evidence.source: BodyCount's own Round 3 results column (30 September 2012, not served) and two promo threads ('R4: Umaga vs. Alexander,' 1-5 October 2012; 'R4: Vayne vs. Hendrix,' opening 6 October 2012), neither served this pass
evidence.note: Names the two semifinal pairings (Umaga Reihana vs. Jakob Alexander; Michael Vayne vs. Dave Hendrix); no results document for either bout survives anywhere in the held record. The fed's own finals recap (21 October 2012) states that Dave Hendrix was disqualified from the tournament after failing a drug test, without narrating the semifinal bout itself, and that Jakob Alexander reached the final -- consistent with Alexander having won his own semifinal, though no card confirms it.

name: Warrior Grand Prix Finals

date.source: BodyCount's own results column, posted 21 October 2012 to its BodyCount Warrior Grand Prix Roleplay sub-forum

matches.stipulation: Warrior Grand Prix final, for the Warrior Grand Prix Championship
matches.note: Viktor Reise won via knockout at 4:42 of the second round to become the first ever Warrior Grand Prix champion.

notes: The final of BodyCount's first Warrior Grand Prix tournament. The card's own opening paragraph explains how Reise reached the final in Dave Hendrix's place (see the Round 3 show's own note).
